title: Cross-sectional reversal across a point-in-time top-20 crypto universe, hourly
hypothesis: Short-horizon cross-sectional reversal is the standard competing hypothesis to momentum, and is claimed to dominate at shorter rebalance intervals. Stated mechanically: Identical to cross-sectional momentum with the ranking inverted: long the worst trailing performers, short the best. Two things make this sweep different from every earlier one in this registry. First, a cross-sectional dollar-neutral portfolio cannot inherit a market trend, so the Bitcoin uptrend that contaminated the time-series crypto results cannot produce an effect here. Second, the universe is rebuilt monthly from the previous month's volume, so coins that later died are held while they lived. Ammann, Burdorf, Liebi and Stockl (SSRN 4287573) measured an annualised survivorship bias of 62.19% for equal-weighted crypto portfolios; taking today's top 20 and backtesting them would make almost any result meaningless.

family_descriptions.xs_reversal: Identical to cross-sectional momentum with the ranking inverted: long the worst trailing performers, short the best.

search_space.enumeration_note: 5 lookback x 3 entry_threshold x 2 exit_rule x 3 holding_cap_bars = 90 fully enumerated variants. Parameters carry cross-sectional meanings: entry_threshold is the fraction of the universe taken on each side, holding_cap_bars is the rebalance interval, and exit_rule selects long-short (opposite_band) or long-only (mean_touch). No symbol count appears because the universe size varies by month and that is the point.

symbols: point-in-time top 20 by prior-month quote volume
data.source: binance public klines via data.binance.vision, see data/manifest/ and data/universe/
data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written
data.universe_note: Membership for each month is the top 20 by quote volume over the PREVIOUS month. Delisted pairs remain in the Binance archive and are included for the months in which they actually traded. No symbol is selected using information from after its membership date.

protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Equal-weighted, dollar-neutral unless exit_rule is long-only. Every variant evaluated over the full period; in-sample/out-of-sample splitting is done by CSCV at scoring time.
protocol.cost_note: 10 bps round trip, against 6 for the single-asset crypto sweeps. Altcoins outside the majors carry materially wider spreads and this strategy rebalances a whole basket, so understating cost here would be the easiest way to manufacture an edge that does not survive contact with an order book.
protocol.execution_model: weights set from bar t close, held over bar t+1, cost charged on the size of every weight change
protocol.survivorship_note: universe rebuilt monthly from prior-month volume; delisted symbols retained for the months they traded

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable.

planning.sd_source: n_observations is an estimate; verify against the assembled panel before freezing.
